name: CORTEX-RAN
full_name: Cognitive Orchestration, Reasoning & Telemetry-driven EXecution for AI-native RAN
tagline: An AI-native RAN control platform, from network intent to radio execution

acronym.meaning: Understanding what the operator wants: natural-language intents are interpreted and reasoned about with LLMs.
Coordinating RAN resources, services and the control applications that act on them.
Learning-based decision making, e.g. deep reinforcement learning, that turns goals into control actions.
Measuring the RAN — KPM and MAC/RLC/PDCP statistics — so every decision is grounded in live state.
Carrying decisions out in the RAN: scheduling, slice/PRB control and radio actions inside the gNB.
The open interfaces that connect it all: E2, A1, O1 and dApp APIs.

platforms.name: OpenAirInterface
platforms.desc: 5G NR gNB / nrUE (rfsim and USRP), FlexRIC nearRT-RIC, E2SM-KPM / RC

platforms.name: ns-3
platforms.desc: ns-3 network simulator with FlexRIC (O-RAN E2 in simulation)

platforms.name: NVIDIA Aerial
platforms.desc: GPU-accelerated L1 (Aerial) with an OAI higher-layer stack on a GB10 host and a physical RU

papers.title: LLM-hRIC: LLM-empowered Hierarchical RAN Intelligent Control for O-RAN
papers.authors: L. Bao, S. Yun, J. Lee, and T. Q. S. Quek

roadmap.title: Phase 1 · Single-loop intelligence
roadmap.theme: AI in one control loop at a time
items: LLM rApp + DRL xApp for intent-driven slicing
DRL xApp + MAC executor for slicing and RU sleep
real-time dApp for interference sensing on I/Q
LLM rApp for mobility load balancing (simulation)
RAN and edge AI co-scheduled on a shared accelerator
cross-layer power profiling and models of a GPU RAN

roadmap.title: Phase 2 · Multi-layer RIC
roadmap.theme: rApps, xApps and dApps as one hierarchy
items: one intent decomposed across rApp → xApp → dApp
conflict management between xApps on one gNB
shared RAN state and telemetry across layers
over-the-air validation of the full hierarchy

roadmap.title: Phase 3 · AI-native RAN stack
items: AI PHY: channel estimation, detection, sensing on GPU
learned MAC scheduling and link adaptation
joint PHY–MAC–RIC loops on every timescale

roadmap.title: Phase 4 · AI-native E2E network
roadmap.theme: RAN and core under one intelligence
items: AI-driven core: session, QoS and UPF policies
end-to-end slicing from UE to data network
